summary: Maps a tire-compound name string to a compound id by a chain of string comparisons against five compound literals via sub_588410 (which returns 0 on an exact match). Exact match against Hard returns 2, Soft returns 3, Intermediate returns 4. The wet string is tested with the opposite polarity: a non-wet input falls into a nested monsoon comparison returning 6 when Monsoon matches and 1 otherwise, while a wet input falls through to the default return 5. Net mapping per the raw source: Hard=2, Soft=3, Intermediate=4, Wet=5, Monsoon=6, any other string=1.

local_names.this: compound name string being classified (first argument to every sub_588410 comparison)

operations.description: Compare the input string against aHardCompound (0x005CD534) via sub_588410 (0x00588410); returns 0 on an exact match
Exact match against the Hard compound returns compound id 2
Compare the input string against aSoftCompound (0x005CD524) via sub_588410
Exact match against the Soft compound returns compound id 3
Compare the input string against aIntermediateCo (0x005CD50C) via sub_588410
Exact match against the Intermediate compound returns compound id 4

Compare the input string against aWetCompound (0x005C7224) via sub_588410; unlike the earlier checks this branch is taken when the comparison returns non-zero, i.e. when the input is NOT the wet compound
If the wet comparison does not match (non-zero), a nested comparison against aMonsoonCompoun selects the returned id; if the input IS the wet compound, control falls through to the default return 5
Compare the input string against aMonsoonCompoun (0x005CD4F8) via sub_588410
Non-wet branch result: return 6 when the Monsoon comparison matches (0), return 1 when it does not match (non-zero)
Default fall-through (input matches the wet compound) returns compound id 5
Shared compound-name classification helper reached from AI and pit paths: sub_429960, RandomWeightedTierSelection (00429fd0), AIPushLap (0042a180), GuardedCallWithCheck (004a5c10) and sub_4F18C0

unresolved: Semantic meaning of the returned compound ids 1-6 (the game's internal tire-compound enum) is not visible in this packet.
Exact string contents of the five compound literals are not in the packet; literal addresses are known only.
sub_588410 is treated as a string-equality helper returning 0 on match per prior analysis; that behavior is not proven by this packet alone.
The wet comparison deliberately uses inverted polarity relative to the other three; whether that is a source-level ordering artifact or a genuine semantic branch is unresolved.
